verses.original: Ἀδελφοί ἐὰν καὶ προλημφθῇ ἄνθρωπος ἔν τινι παραπτώματι ὑμεῖς οἱ πνευματικοὶ καταρτίζετε τὸν τοιοῦτον ἐν πνεύματι πραΰτητος σκοπῶν σεαυτόν μὴ καὶ σὺ πειρασθῇς
verses.transliteration: Adelphoi ean kai prolēmphthē anthrōpos en tini paraptōmati hymeis hoi pneumatikoi katartizete ton toiouton en pneumati prautētos skopōn seauton mē kai sy peirasthēs
verses.literal: Brothers if someone is caught in a trespass you who are spiritual should restore him with a spirit of gentleness But watch yourself or you also may be tempted
verses.literalPt: Irmãos, se um homem for surpreendido em algum delito, vós, que sois espirituais, restaurai o tal num espírito de mansidão; e tu olha a ti mesmo, para que não sejas também tentado.

verses.original: Ἀλλήλων τὰ βάρη βαστάζετε καὶ οὕτως ἀναπληρώσετε τὸν νόμον τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Allēlōn ta barē bastazete kai houtōs anaplērōsete ton nomon tou Christou
verses.literal: Carry one another’s burdens and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ
verses.literalPt: Levai as cargas uns dos outros e, assim, cumprireis a lei de Cristo.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ δοκεῖ τις εἶναί τι μηδὲν ὤν φρεναπατᾷ ἑαυτόν
verses.transliteration: ei gar dokei tis einai ti mēden ōn phrenapata heauton
verses.literal: If anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing he deceives himself
verses.literalPt: Pois, se alguém pensa ser alguma coisa, não sendo nada, engana-se a si mesmo.

verses.original: Τὸ δὲ ἔργον ἑαυτοῦ δοκιμαζέτω ἕκαστος καὶ τότε εἰς ἑαυτὸν μόνον τὸ καύχημα ἕξει καὶ οὐκ εἰς τὸν ἕτερον
verses.transliteration: To de ergon heautou dokimazetō hekastos kai tote eis heauton monon to kauchēma hexei kai ouk eis ton heteron
verses.literal: Each one should test his own work Then he will have reason to boast in himself alone and not in someone else
verses.literalPt: Mas cada um prove a sua obra e, então, terá o seu motivo de glória em si mesmo somente e não em outrem;

verses.original: ἕκαστος γὰρ τὸ ἴδιον φορτίον βαστάσει
verses.transliteration: hekastos gar to idion phortion bastasei
verses.literal: For each one should carry his own load
verses.literalPt: pois cada um levará o seu próprio fardo.

verses.original: Κοινωνείτω δὲ ὁ κατηχούμενος τὸν λόγον τῷ κατηχοῦντι ἐν πᾶσιν ἀγαθοῖς
verses.transliteration: Koinōneitō de ho katēchoumenos ton logon tō katēchounti en pasin agathois
verses.literal: Nevertheless the one who receives instruction in the word must share in all good things with his instructor
verses.literalPt: Mas aquele que é ensinado na palavra faça participante em todas as coisas boas aquele que o ensina.

verses.original: Μὴ πλανᾶσθε Θεὸς οὐ μυκτηρίζεται ὃ γὰρ ἐὰν σπείρῃ ἄνθρωπος τοῦτο καὶ θερίσει
verses.transliteration: Mē planasthe Theos ou myktērizetai ho gar ean speirē anthrōpos touto kai therisei
verses.literal: Do not be deceived God is not to be mocked Whatever . . . a man sows he will reap in return
verses.literalPt: Não vos enganeis; de Deus não se zomba. Pois aquilo que o homem semear, isso também ceifará.

verses.original: ὅτι ὁ σπείρων εἰς τὴν σάρκα ἑαυτοῦ ἐκ τῆς σαρκὸς θερίσει φθοράν ὁ δὲ σπείρων εἰς τὸ Πνεῦμα ἐκ τοῦ Πνεύματος θερίσει ζωὴν αἰώνιον
verses.transliteration: hoti ho speirōn eis tēn sarka heautou ek tēs sarkos therisei phthoran ho de speirōn eis to Pneuma ek tou Pneumatos therisei zōēn aiōnion
verses.literal: The one who sows to please his flesh from the flesh will reap destruction but the one who sows to please the Spirit from the Spirit will reap eternal life
verses.literalPt: Porque o que semeia na sua carne, da carne ceifará corrupção; mas o que semeia no Espírito, do Espírito ceifará vida eterna.

verses.original: Τὸ δὲ καλὸν ποιοῦντες μὴ ἐνκακῶμεν καιρῷ γὰρ ἰδίῳ θερίσομεν μὴ ἐκλυόμενοι
verses.transliteration: To de kalon poiountes mē enkakōmen kairō gar idiō therisomen mē eklyomenoi
verses.literal: Let us not grow weary in well-doing . . . for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up
verses.literalPt: Não nos desanimemos de fazer o bem; pois a seu tempo ceifaremos, se não desfalecermos.

verses.original: Ἄρα οὖν ὡς καιρὸν ἔχομεν ἐργαζώμεθα τὸ ἀγαθὸν πρὸς πάντας μάλιστα δὲ πρὸς τοὺς οἰκείους τῆς πίστεως
verses.transliteration: Ara oun hōs kairon echomen ergazōmetha to agathon pros pantas malista de pros tous oikeious tēs pisteōs
verses.literal: Therefore as we have opportunity let us do good to everyone and especially to the family of faith
verses.literalPt: Portanto, à medida que tivermos oportunidade, façamos o que é bom a todos os homens, mas, especialmente, aos que pertencem à família da fé.

verses.original: Ἴδετε πηλίκοις ὑμῖν γράμμασιν ἔγραψα τῇ ἐμῇ χειρί
verses.transliteration: Idete pēlikois hymin grammasin egrapsa tē emē cheiri
verses.literal: See what large letters I am using to write to you with my own hand
verses.literalPt: Vede com que letras grandes vos escrevo com a minha própria mão.

verses.original: Ὅσοι θέλουσιν εὐπροσωπῆσαι ἐν σαρκί οὗτοι ἀναγκάζουσιν ὑμᾶς περιτέμνεσθαι μόνον ἵνα τῷ σταυρῷ τοῦ Χριστοῦ μὴ διώκωνται
verses.transliteration: Hosoi thelousin euprosōpēsai en sarki houtoi anankazousin hymas peritemnesthai monon hina tō staurō tou Christou mē diōkōntai
verses.literal: Those who want to make a good impression outwardly are trying to compel you to be circumcised They only do this to avoid persecution for the cross of Christ
verses.literalPt: Todos os que querem ostentar boa aparência na carne, estes vos obrigam a ser circuncidados, somente para que não sejam perseguidos por causa da cruz de Cristo.

verses.original: οὐδὲ γὰρ οἱ περιτεμνόμενοι αὐτοὶ νόμον φυλάσσουσιν ἀλλὰ θέλουσιν ὑμᾶς περιτέμνεσθαι ἵνα ἐν τῇ ὑμετέρᾳ σαρκὶ καυχήσωνται
verses.transliteration: oude gar hoi peritemnomenoi autoi nomon phylassousin alla thelousin hymas peritemnesthai hina en tē hymetera sarki kauchēsōntai
verses.literal: For the circumcised do not even keep the law themselves yet they want you to be circumcised that they may boast in your flesh
verses.literalPt: Pois nem mesmo aqueles que se deixam circuncidar guardam a Lei; antes, querem fazer-vos circuncidar para se gloriarem na vossa carne.

verses.original: Ἐμοὶ δὲ μὴ γένοιτο καυχᾶσθαι εἰ μὴ ἐν τῷ σταυρῷ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δι’ οὗ ἐμοὶ κόσμος ἐσταύρωται κἀγὼ κόσμῳ
verses.transliteration: Emoi de mē genoito kauchasthai ei mē en tō staurō tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou di’ hou emoi kosmos estaurōtai kagō kosmō
verses.literal: But as for me may I never boast except . . . in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ through which the world has been crucified to me and I to the world
verses.literalPt: Mas longe de mim esteja o gloriar-me, a não ser na cruz de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, pela qual o mundo tem sido crucificado para mim, e eu, para o mundo.

verses.original: οὔτε γὰρ περιτομή τί ἐστιν οὔτε ἀκροβυστία ἀλλὰ καινὴ κτίσις
verses.transliteration: oute gar peritomē ti estin oute akrobystia alla kainē ktisis
verses.literal: For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything What counts is a new creation
verses.literalPt: Pois nem a circuncisão é coisa alguma nem a incircuncisão, mas o ser uma nova criação.

verses.original: Καὶ ὅσοι τῷ κανόνι τούτῳ στοιχήσουσιν εἰρήνη ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς καὶ ἔλεος καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰσραὴλ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai hosoi tō kanoni toutō stoichēsousin eirēnē ep’ autous kai eleos kai epi ton Israēl tou Theou
verses.literal: Peace and mercy to all who walk by this rule even to the Israel of God
verses.literalPt: Quantos andarem por essa norma, paz e misericórdia sejam sobre eles e sobre o Israel de Deus.

verses.original: Τοῦ λοιποῦ κόπους μοι μηδεὶς παρεχέτω ἐγὼ γὰρ τὰ στίγματα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐν τῷ σώματί μου βαστάζω
verses.transliteration: Tou loipou kopous moi mēdeis parechetō egō gar ta stigmata tou Iēsou en tō sōmati mou bastazō
verses.literal: From now on let no one cause me trouble for I bear on my body the marks of Jesus
verses.literalPt: Daqui em diante, ninguém me moleste; pois eu trago em meu corpo as marcas de Jesus.

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ τοῦ πνεύματος ὑμῶν ἀδελφοί Ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: Hē charis tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou meta tou pneumatos hymōn adelphoi Amēn
verses.literal: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit brothers Amen
verses.literalPt: A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja com o vosso espírito, irmãos. Amém.
